vachanas.kannada:
ಅಂಗದ ಮೇಲೆ ಲಿಂಗವಿದ್ದ ಬಳಿಕ, ಲಿಂಗಹೀನರ ಬೆರಸಲಾಗದು.
ಅಂಗದ ಮೇಲೆ ಲಿಂಗವಿದ್ದ ಬಳಿಕ,
ಲಿಂಗ ಮುಂತಾಗಿ ಎಲ್ಲಾ  ಕ್ರೀಗಳನೂ ಗಮಿಸಬೇಕಲ್ಲದೆ,
ಅಂಗ ಮುಂತಾಗಿ ಗಮನಿಸಲಾಗದು.
ಲಿಂಗಸಂಬಂಧಿಯಾಗಿ ಅಂಗ ಮುಂತಾಗಿಪ್ಪವರು ಲಿಂಗಕ್ಕೆ ದೂರವಯ್ಯಾ,
ನಾಗಪ್ರಿಯ ಚೆನ್ನರಾಮೇಶ್ವರಾ.
vachanas.transliteration:
aṅgada mēle liṅgavidda baḷika, liṅgahīnara berasalāgadu.
aṅgada mēle liṅgavidda baḷika,
liṅga muntāgi ellā  krīgaḷanū gamisabēkallade,
aṅga muntāgi gamanisalāgadu.
liṅgasambandhiyāgi aṅga muntāgippavaru liṅgakke dūravayyā,
nāgapriya cennarāmēśvarā.
vachanas.translation:
Once the Liṅga has been established upon the body, one can no longer keep the company of those without the Liṅga.
Once the Liṅga is established upon the body,
One must henceforth regard everything in relation to the Liṅga and its sacred observances,
And not in relation to the body.
Those who continue to place the body before the Liṅga, even while professing a relationship with it, remain far from the Liṅga,
O Cennarāmeśvara, Beloved of the Serpent.

vachanas.kannada:
ಘನಸುಖ ಮಹಾಸುಖವ ಮುಟ್ಟಲು, ಸಮಸುಖಂಗಳ ಸುಖಿಸಬಲ್ಲ,
ಸುಖವನಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ಕೊಯ್ದು ಸೂಡ ಕಟ್ಟಬಲ್ಲ,
ನಾಗಪ್ರಿಯ ಚೆನ್ನರಾಮೇಶ್ವರಾ,
ನಿಮ್ಮ ಶರಣನು ಸುಖಿಸಬಲ್ಲ ಸುಖವನು.
vachanas.transliteration:
ghanasukha mahāsukhava muṭṭalu, samasukhaṅgaḷa sukhisaballa,
sukhavanalliyē koydu sūḍa kaṭṭaballa,
nāgapriya cennarāmēśvarā,
nim'ma śaraṇanu sukhisaballa sukhavanu.
vachanas.translation:
To attain the profound bliss, the supreme bliss,
One must first be capable of experiencing the ordinary forms of joy.
Then, even from within that joy, one must gather and bind it into the higher Bliss.
O Cennarāmeśvara, Beloved of the Serpent,
Your Śaraṇa alone knows how to rejoice in that Bliss.

vachanas.kannada:
ಹುಟ್ಟಿದಾಕ್ಷಣವೆ ಲಿಂಗಸ್ವಾಯತವ ಮಾಡಿ,
ಶಿಶುವ ತನ್ನ  ಶಿಶುವೆಂದು ಮುಖವ ನೋಡುವದು ಸದಾಚಾರ.
ಅದಲ್ಲದೆ, ಬರಿಯ ವಿಭೂತಿಯ ಪಟ್ಟವ ಕಟ್ಟಿ,
ಗುರುಕಾರುಣ್ಯವಾಯಿತ್ತೆಂದು
ಅನುಸರಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಡಿಕೊಂಬುದು ಕ್ರಮವಲ್ಲ.
ಅದೇನು ಕಾರಣವೆಂದಡೆ, ತಾ ಲಿಂಗದೇಹಿಯಾದುದಕ್ಕೆ ಕುರುಹು.
ಲಿಂಗವುಳ್ಳವರೆಲ್ಲರ ತನ್ನವರೆನ್ನಬೇಕಲ್ಲದೆ,
ಲಿಂಗವಿಲ್ಲದವರ ತನ್ನವರೆಂದಡೆ, ತನ್ನ ಸದಾಚಾರಕ್ಕೆ ದ್ರೋಹಬಹುದು,
ಸಮಯಾಚಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಮುನ್ನವೇ ಸಲ್ಲ.
ಇದು ಕಾರಣ, ಲಿಂಗಸ್ವಾಯತವಾಗಿಹುದೆ ಪಥವಯ್ಯಾ,
ನಾಗಪ್ರಿಯ ಚೆನ್ನರಾಮೇಶ್ವರಾ.
vachanas.transliteration:
huṭṭidākṣaṇave liṅgasvāyatava māḍi,
śiśuva tanna  śiśuvendu mukhava nōḍuvadu sadācāra.
adallade, bariya vibhūtiya paṭṭava kaṭṭi,
gurukāruṇyavāyittendu
anusaraṇeyalli āḍikombudu kramavalla.
adēnu kāraṇavendaḍe, tā liṅgadēhiyādudakke kuruhu.
liṅgavuḷḷavarellara tannavarennabēkallade,
liṅgavilladavara tannavarendaḍe, tanna sadācārakke drōhabahudu,
samayācārakke munnavē salla.
idu kāraṇa, liṅgasvāyatavāgihude pathavayyā,
nāgapriya cennarāmēśvarā.
vachanas.translation:
From the very moment of birth, the child should be made self-established in the Liṅga;
For the parents to behold the infant as truly their own child only after this is the right conduct (Sadācāra).
Merely tying on a strip of sacred ash,
And claiming, "The Guru's grace has been received,"
Without following the proper discipline, is not the true way.
Why? Because the Liṅga itself is the mark that one has become embodied in the Liṅga.
One should regard all who bear the Liṅga as one's own;
But if one treats those without the Liṅga as though they stand in the same spiritual relationship, one may betray one's own Sadācāra.
Such conduct is not in keeping even with the first stage of Samayācāra.
Therefore, being firmly established in the Liṅga from the very beginning is the true path,
O Cennarāmeśvara, Beloved of the Serpent.
